test_title: PYST 36 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 26 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. He crafted his thoughts into a careful message, his fingers flying across the keys.

Q. He swiftly entered a lengthy string of characters and numbers that was the recipient's email address.

R. A simple subject line summarizes the entire point of the message.

S. He breathed a last sigh of relief as he hit the send button and saw the email disappear.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins by describing the action of entering an email address, which sets the starting point of the sequence.
 
• **Sentence Q is the first sentence** as it introduces the act of entering the email address:
 
 
• "He swiftly entered a lengthy string of characters and numbers that was the recipient's email address."
